MyCiTi Announcements
MyCiTi Announcements
HAVE YOUR SAY: NEW STOPS IN KHAYELITSHA
06 November 2026

Two new stops are proposed along the D02 route in Khayelitsha after an assessment of public requests to make it easier and safer to catch the bus in the area.
CAPE TOWN CYCLE TOUR
06 November 2026

Cape Town Cycle Tour participants can enjoy a free shuttle service operated by MyCiTi for race day on Sunday 9 March and to visit the expo daily from Thursday 6 March until Saturday 8 March.
CONSTRUCTION OF PERMANENT STOPS
28 August 2026

Work is underway to convert temporary poles into permanent bus stop structures across the footprint. Services will remain operational at all affected stops.
